retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0xBFF; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0x85FF it reads empty (K.O. audit)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0xBFF; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0x85FF it reads empty (K.O. audit)

backdrop.note: the stage (the robot's recordings of 2026-11-15 and 16: one value through a fight, the same backdrop on the screenshots each time the value comes back, in both recordings). Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_time.note: the timer, from 120 (the robot's recording of 2026-11-15: the only byte that holds the number of five screenshots). Read but not shown yet: the same byte counts 11, 10 before the round, which the fight engine takes for a round of its own, and three digits do not fit the timer's frame

score_p2.note: player 2, to find with learn.bat (two-player game, score2=...)

hd.note: HD screen theme and place for each backdrop value (index = value), see the wiki, HD Marquee page. Set from the screenshots of the robot's recordings: 1 a forest, 2 a shopping street at night, 3 a basketball court, 4 a desert road, 6 a Chinese garden with a waterfall, 8 a car park under the skyline, 9 a ring. 5 and 7 were not met: the arena, no place named. The game names no fighter on its fight screen, none is named here
